display.name: Parser Security — Fuzzing Research (#114)
display.description: Live fuzzing research dashboard. Run-level crux metrics (vulns per walltime, per model/target) + per-cycle live curves (execs/s, coverage, crashes). Test rows (target testparser/unknown) are filtered out. The `model` axis only populates for runs started after the #114 telemetry commit.

spec.query:
select
    sum((attributes->>'score._live_fuzzing_scorer.eff_vulns')::float) as "Unique crashes"
from records
where message = 'eval sample'
  and attributes->>'sample.id' like 'live-fuzzing%'
  and attributes->>'error' = 'false'
  and attributes->>'target' not in ('testparser', 'unknown')

display.name: Vulns per fuzz-hour, by target (the crux)

spec.query:
select * from (
  select
      round(
        sum((attributes->>'score._live_fuzzing_scorer.eff_vulns')::float)
        / nullif(sum((attributes->>'score._live_fuzzing_scorer.eff_fuzz_seconds')::float) / 3600, 0)
      , 3) as vulns_per_fuzz_hour,
      attributes->>'target' as target
  from records
  where message = 'eval sample'
    and attributes->>'sample.id' like 'live-fuzzing%'
    and attributes->>'error' = 'false'
    and attributes->>'target' not in ('testparser', 'unknown')
  group by target
) order by vulns_per_fuzz_hour desc

display.name: Vulns per fuzz-hour, by model (#114 — populates on new runs)

spec.query:
select * from (
  select
      round(
        sum((attributes->>'score._live_fuzzing_scorer.eff_vulns')::float)
        / nullif(sum((attributes->>'score._live_fuzzing_scorer.eff_fuzz_seconds')::float) / 3600, 0)
      , 3) as vulns_per_fuzz_hour,
      coalesce(attributes->>'model', '(model not recorded)') as model
  from records
  where message = 'eval sample'
    and attributes->>'sample.id' like 'live-fuzzing%'
    and attributes->>'error' = 'false'
    and attributes->>'target' not in ('testparser', 'unknown')
  group by model
) order by vulns_per_fuzz_hour desc

select * from (
  select
      round(100.0 * sum(case when attributes->>'error' = 'true' then 1 else 0 end)
            / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) as error_pct,
      attributes->>'target' as target
  from records
  where message = 'eval sample'
    and attributes->>'sample.id' like 'live-fuzzing%'
    and attributes->>'target' not in ('testparser', 'unknown')
  group by target
) order by error_pct desc

select
    avg((attributes->>'execs_per_sec')::float) as execs_per_sec,
    attributes->>'target' as target,
    time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) as x
from records
where message = 'fuzz cycle complete'
  and attributes->>'target' not in ('testparser', 'unknown')
group by x, target

display.name: Peak coverage (libFuzzer PCs) over time, by target

spec.query:
select
    max((attributes->>'coverage_pcs')::int) as coverage_pcs,
    attributes->>'target' as target,
    time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) as x
from records
where message = 'fuzz cycle complete'
  and attributes->>'target' not in ('testparser', 'unknown')
group by x, target

display.name: Unique crashes over time, by target

spec.query:
select
    max((attributes->>'crashes_total')::int) as crashes_total,
    attributes->>'target' as target,
    time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) as x
from records
where message = 'fuzz cycle complete'
  and attributes->>'target' not in ('testparser', 'unknown')
group by x, target
